input_fields.name: expected_root
input_fields.description: Expected current root Part identity and binding.

input_fields.name: run_root
input_fields.description: Absolute run-owned directory; not a baseline, evidence, or existing-output ancestor.

input_fields.name: output_path
input_fields.description: New .scdoc path under run_root; it must not already exist.

input_fields.name: critical_checks
input_fields.description: Checks with id and status; every critical check must be passed.

result_fields.name: sha256
result_fields.description: SHA-256 of the saved native-model bytes.

result_fields.name: native_save
result_fields.description: passed only after native save and hash succeed.

result_fields.name: native_reopen
result_fields.description: Always not_tested for this save-only operation.

procedure: Validate expected_root, run_root ownership, extension, new-output condition, and every critical_checks status.
Invoke the formal save artifact once for the current root Part and output_path.
Hash the native file and return path, SHA-256, native_save, and native_reopen=not_tested.
Do not open/reopen the saved file; reopen evidence belongs to a separate operation.
rejection_rules: Reject existing output, path outside run_root, reparse/ancestor collision, root mismatch, failed/missing check, or save error.
Reject any native reopen claim from EX-14.
Do not overwrite baseline/evidence or substitute another path.
